مُسَافِعٌ (assumed tropical:) Striking, or beating, another, being struck, or beaten, by him. (K.) (assumed tropical:) Charging upon, or assaulting, or attacking, another who is doing the same. (K.) ―
-b2- [And hence,] (assumed tropical:) The lion (K, TA) that prostrates his prey. (TA.) ―
-b3- (assumed tropical:) Embracing. (K.) ―
-b4- (tropical:) I. q. مُسَافِحٌ; (Ibn-'Abbád, K;) i. e. having sexual intercourse without marriage. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
